metadata.title: Network security incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw packets); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 10.2.28.0/24 (10.2.28.0 through 10.2.28.255); Domain: easyas123.tech; AD environment name: EASYAS123; Active Directory (AD) domain controller: 10.2.28.2 - EASYAS123-DC; LAN segment gateway: 10.2.28.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 10.2.28.255.
investigation_questions: What is the IP address of the infected Windows client?
What is the host name of the infected Windows client?
What is the Windows human user account name (not machine accounts ending in $) of the potentially infected machine in the LAN?
What are the suspicious external IP addresses contacted, which might be involved in command-and-control (C2) communication?
During what hour did the first signs of infection activity appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.
According to the connection volume statistics, what single external IP address received the most connections from the infected hosts? Is it a C2 server or a legitimate service?
